say:2:1029501001:1.text: You came from over there; does that mean... You really went to the Moon Temple to hear the divine revelation?
say:2:1029501001:1.source_cn: 你们从那个方向过来，难道说……你们真的去月神遗殿聆听神...

say:3:1029501002:1.text: Of course! I lent the moonstone to the magister to throw into the Moon Temple spring.
say:3:1029501002:1.source_cn: 当然！我把月光石借给老师，投入月神殿的泉眼内了。
say:3:1029501002:1.male: Of course! I lent the moonstone to the magister to throw into the Moon Temple spring.
say:3:1029501002:1.female: Of course! I lent the moonstone to the magister to throw into the Moon Temple spring.

say:4:1029501003:1.text: You're too reckless! I haven't even finished researching this legend...
say:4:1029501003:1.source_cn: 你也太莽撞了，我还没有做完这个传说的考证……

say:5:1029501004:1.text: Of course I was going to try if I got the chance!
say:5:1029501004:1.source_cn: 难得有机会当然要试验一下！

choice_prompt:6:1029501004.text: Of course I was going to try if I got the chance!
choice_prompt:6:1029501004.source_cn: 难得有机会当然要试验一下！

say:7:1029501005:1.text: Ah, that's a relief. As long as nothing strange happened...
say:7:1029501005:1.source_cn: 那我就放心了，没有发生奇怪的事情就好。

say:9:1029501006:1.text: Well... Now that you mention it...

say:13:1029501008:1.text: We didn't exactly succeed in gaining Nakalig's revelation...
say:13:1029501008:1.source_cn: 某种程度上来说，并没有成功获得月神的启示——

say:15:1029501010:0.text: But we did meet the Celestial, Dionel.
say:15:1029501010:0.source_cn: 但我们见到了半神萨基塔里斯大人。

say:16:1029501011:1.text: What?! That amazing Celestial? There must be so many academic questions one could consult him about!
say:16:1029501011:1.source_cn: 什么？！那可是半神大人！一定有很多学术问题可以向他求证。

say:17:1029501012:1.text: What was his magic like? What was HE like? Did he carry a spear?
say:17:1029501012:1.source_cn: 半神大人的魔力是怎样的！半神大人样貌呢？他有手握长矛吗？

say:18:1029501013:1.text: It's said that he's already lived for centuries. I'd love to see him with my own eyes...
say:18:1029501013:1.source_cn: 据说他已经度过了几百年岁月，我也好想亲眼见证他的身姿啊……

say:19:1029501014:1.text: However, if this legend has some basis in reality, then another may be feasible too.
say:19:1029501014:1.source_cn: 不过，如果这个传说是有一定现实依据的话，另一个传说也有...

say:22:1029501016:1.text: The second legend says that there are TWO springs hidden in the Moon Temple. The treasure of Nakalig awaits whoever can activate them both.
say:22:1029501016:1.source_cn: 第二个传说是，月神遗殿隐藏着两个泉眼。如果能打开两处泉...

say:23:1029501017:0.text: I've already confirmed the spring's location, but I haven't a clue how to activate it or what Nakalig's treasure actually is.
say:23:1029501017:0.source_cn: 泉眼的位置我已经确定了，但是具体如何开启以及月神的宝藏...

say:24:1029501018:0.text: I'm not overly interested in the treasure itself, but I'm dying to see what the treasure of a Celestial could be. Please, I beg you!
say:24:1029501018:0.source_cn: 我对宝藏本身并不感兴趣，只想窥得何为神的宝藏。拜托你们了！

choice:6:0:1.text: Fay did a good job this time.
choice:6:0:1.male: Fay did a good job this time.
choice:6:0:1.female: Fay did a good job this time.

say:0:1029502001:0.text: Spring... Spring... Shouldn't it be right around here?
say:0:1029502001:0.source_cn: 泉眼……泉眼……就是在这里吧！

say:1:1029502002:0.text: Magister! Let's have a closer look around!
say:1:1029502002:0.source_cn: 老师！我们在附近仔细看看吧！
say:1:1029502002:0.male: Magister! Let's have a closer look around!
say:1:1029502002:0.female: Magister! Let's have a closer look around!

say:0:1029503001:0.text: Strange... I can't really see if anything is in the water...
say:0:1029503001:0.source_cn: 好奇怪，透过水面好像看不到里面有东西……

say:3:1029504001:1.text: Pah! I looked all over, but there's nothing special here.
say:3:1029504001:1.source_cn: 呼……看了一大圈，这里也没什么特殊的啊。

say:4:1029504002:1.text: I thought it would be something like a cave with buried gems that we could find just by digging.
say:4:1029504002:1.source_cn: 我还以为会是类似埋藏宝石的洞穴那样，挖开土就能找到了。

say:5:1029504003:1.text: A secret that could be solved just like that wouldn't have become a legend about Celestials.
say:5:1029504003:1.source_cn: 如果是随意就能被解开的秘密，也不会成为与神有关的传说。

say:6:1029504004:1.text: It takes courage, wisdom, and piety to discern the traces of a Celestial.
say:6:1029504004:1.source_cn: 神的行迹，需要用勇气，智慧，虔诚才可窥得一二。

say:7:1029504005:1.text: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:7:1029504005:1.source_cn: 不过在这附近，确实没有找到可用的线索。<style=s...
say:7:1029504005:1.male: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:7:1029504005:1.female: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice_prompt:8:1029504005.text: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:8:1029504005.source_cn: 不过在这附近，确实没有找到可用的线索。<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，怎么说？
choice_prompt:8:1029504005.male: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:8:1029504005.female: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:9:1029504006:1.text: Alya's the best of the bunch. If she only got part of it...
say:9:1029504006:1.source_cn: 阿莉雅已经是最厉害的学者了，如果她只考证到一部分……

say:10:1029504007:1.text: Other scholars are unlikely to have any further info.
say:10:1029504007:1.source_cn: 其他的学者也不可能再掌握更多信息了。

say:11:1029504008:1.text: Maybe people in the nearby villages know something about Nakalig's treasure. Let's go ask around.
say:11:1029504008:1.source_cn: 关于月神的宝藏，附近村落中的人或许会知道什么。找他们打...

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 找附近的学者们打探一下？

say:13:1029504009:2.text: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, we might as well take a nap—
say:13:1029504009:2.male: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, we might as well take a nap—
say:13:1029504009:2.female: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, we might as well take a nap—

say:16:1029504011:1.text: Fine, then, humorless knight. Let's go ask the locals.
say:16:1029504011:1.source_cn: 好吧，没有幽默感的圣骑士。那我们向附近的居民打听看看吧。

choice:8:1:2.text: Maybe we should sleep on it.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 也许睡一觉会有新线索
choice:8:1:2.male: Maybe we should sleep on it.
choice:8:1:2.female: Maybe we should sleep on it.

say:17:1029504012:1.text: Yes, they might be able to offer some clues.
say:17:1029504012:1.source_cn: 嗯，他们可能会有一些辅助的线索。

say:18:1029504013:1.source_cn: 那我们就在附近找找看！

say:0:1029505001:0.text: I think there's someone over there, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:0:1029505001:0.male: I think there's someone over there, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:0:1029505001:0.female: I think there's someone over there, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:1:1029505002:0.source_cn: 看样子，确实是附近的居民。

say:2:1029505003:0.text: Leave the talking to me! I'm great at communicating with people!
say:2:1029505003:0.source_cn: 搭话的任务就交给我吧！我很擅长与人沟通的！

say:2:1029506001:2.text: Hi there! I'm Fay! Do you live around here?
say:2:1029506001:2.source_cn: 你好呀~我叫菲！你是住在这附近的村民吗？

say:3:1029506002:2.text: Oh! H-Hello. I'm Tessis. I used to live in the village just ahead...
say:3:1029506002:2.source_cn: 啊……你、你好，我叫泰瑟丝。我以前就住在前面的村落里……

say:4:1029506003:1.text: But because of some... Well, I've had to move elsewhere temporarily.
say:4:1029506003:1.source_cn: 因为一些……总之，现在搬去了别的地方暂住。

choice_prompt:6:1029506003.text: But because of some... Well, I've had to move elsewhere temporarily.
choice_prompt:6:1029506003.source_cn: 因为一些……总之，现在搬去了别的地方暂住。

say:7:1029506004:1.text: Yes, and the father of my child... I have to live with my parents at present...
say:7:1029506004:1.source_cn: 是的，孩子的父亲也……我现在只能和父母一起生活……

say:8:1029506005:1.text: But never mind that. What can I do for you?
say:8:1029506005:1.source_cn: 不提这些了，你们有什么事吗？

say:12:1029506010:1.text: Didn't Nakalig fall long ago? Although I do believe I've heard of one.
say:12:1029506010:1.source_cn: 月神不是早早地陨落了吗？虽然我确实有听说过这个传说。

say:13:1029506011:1.text: When I was little, I once played in the Moon Temple, and some of my friends mentioned it. A pity they're no longer here...
say:13:1029506011:1.source_cn: 小时候去月神遗殿玩耍的时候，有小伙伴提过，可惜他们也不...

say:15:1029506012:2.text: Do you know who else we could ask?
say:15:1029506012:2.source_cn: 请问，还有别的人可以打听这件事吗？

say:16:1029506013:1.text: I asked my father once when I was little, and he mentioned something.
say:16:1029506013:1.source_cn: 我小时候曾经问过我的父亲，他有提到过什么。

say:17:1029506014:1.text: Could you possibly take us to speak to your father? Please?
say:17:1029506014:1.source_cn: 请问，你可以带我们去找你的父亲吗？

say:19:1029506016:1.text: Forgive my companion's brashness, madam. We meant no offense.
say:19:1029506016:1.source_cn: 对不起这位女士，我们的同伴性格有些莽撞，并不是要冒犯您。

say:20:1029506017:1.text: I don't mind. It's just that I'm here to gather scarlet pomes for my son. I promised him I'd bring back a whole bag...
say:20:1029506017:1.source_cn: 我不介意啦，只是我今天出来是为了我的孩子采集赤珠果，我...

say:22:1029506018:1.text: Then allow us—and my great strength—to help!
say:22:1029506018:1.source_cn: 那请让我们来帮助您采集！我的力气很大！

say:23:1029506019:1.text: I've got a great sense of smell!

say:25:1029506020:1.text: And I've got great hearing! Even though I don't know how that would help...

choice_prompt:26:1029506020.text: And I've got great hearing! Even though I don't know how that would help...

say:28:1029506022:1.text: You're a funny bunch, aren't you? But thank you, all the same!
say:28:1029506022:1.source_cn: 你们还真是一群有趣的人，那就拜托了！

say:29:1029506023:1.text: Once there's enough scarlet pome, you must come to my home as my guest.
say:29:1029506023:1.source_cn: 采集足够赤珠果后，请务必来我家做客。

choice:11:0:1.text: Know any legends about the moon god?
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 我们在寻找月神的宝藏
choice:11:0:1.male: Know any legends about the moon god?
choice:11:0:1.female: Know any legends about the moon god?

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 你听说过月神的宝藏吗？

say:31:1029506006:1.text: Even without the golems, some oddballs also turned up to cause trouble.
say:31:1029506006:1.source_cn: 还不是魔偶闹得，后面又来了一些怪人，就更热闹了。

say:32:1029506007:1.text: It doesn't matter, at least we have somewhere to live. So, what did you want to ask?
say:32:1029506007:1.source_cn: 不说了，我们现在还算有地方可以住。你们是想打听什么？

say:2:1029508001:1.text: Oh wow! My son will be ecstatic when he sees them.
say:2:1029508001:1.source_cn: 这么多蜜果，我的孩子看到一定会非常开心的。

say:3:1029508002:1.text: Just looking at the bag makes me want to eat some too...
say:3:1029508002:1.source_cn: 看着满满一筐，我也有点想吃蜜果了……

say:4:1029508003:1.text: Miss Fay, once we reach my house, I'll prepare the sweetest one for you.
say:4:1029508003:1.source_cn: 菲小姐，等到了我家，我会拿出最甜的蜜果招待你。

say:0:1029509001:0.text: Wait. Up ahead... Something feels off.
say:0:1029509001:0.source_cn: 等一下，前面的气息有些不对劲。

say:1:1029509002:0.text: My home's that way... My son and parents are there!
say:1:1029509002:0.source_cn: 那是我家的方向……我的孩子和父母还在家！

say:2:1029509003:0.text: Fear not. There's no way we could ignore this.
say:2:1029509003:0.source_cn: 放心，魔法师和骑士们可不会对此置之不理。

say:3:1029510001:1.text: Thank you for saving my family...
say:3:1029510001:1.source_cn: 感谢你们，及时救了我的亲人……

say:4:1029510002:1.text: Dura above, thank heavens the child and elderly weren't injured!
say:4:1029510002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，孩子与老人没有受伤就好！

say:5:1029510003:0.text: I don't know how to thank you enough!
say:5:1029510003:0.source_cn: 真是不知道要怎么感谢你们才好！

say:6:1029510004:1.text: Father, they're here on the trail of Nakalig's legendary treasure. Do you still remember the bedtime stories you used to tell me?
say:6:1029510004:1.source_cn: 父亲，他们是为了追寻月神宝藏的传说而来，你还记得给我小...

say:7:1029510005:1.text: Ah, I see. So you're here to search for the moon god's treasure, eh?
say:7:1029510005:1.source_cn: 原来如此，各位大人是来寻找月神宝藏的吗？

choice_prompt:8:1029510005.text: Ah, I see. So you're here to search for the moon god's treasure, eh?
choice_prompt:8:1029510005.source_cn: 原来如此，各位大人是来寻找月神宝藏的吗？

say:9:1029510006:3.text: Is it a bedtime story?! I wanna eat fruit and listen to Grandpa!
say:9:1029510006:3.source_cn: 是睡前故事吗？妈妈，我想一边吃赤珠果一边听外公讲！

say:10:1029510007:1.text: Alright, then, I'll tell it. The legend of the moon god's treasure has been passed down through the generations.
say:10:1029510007:1.source_cn: 好吧好吧，我这就讲。月神的宝藏，是我们祖辈留下的一个传...

say:11:1029510008:1.text: It's said that Nakalig placed his precious items in a spring that could be illuminated by moonlight.
say:11:1029510008:1.source_cn: 传说月神把自己的珍贵之物，放入了可以被月光照亮的泉水之中。

say:12:1029510009:1.text: But he feared that others would desire his treasures if they shone too brightly in the dark.
say:12:1029510009:1.source_cn: 但他担心自己珍贵之物在黑夜中太过耀眼，会被他人觊觎。

say:13:1029510010:1.text: So he covered up the spring, which could only be awakened by solving his puzzle.
say:13:1029510010:1.source_cn: 于是他将泉眼掩盖起来，只有解开他的谜题才能唤起泉眼。

say:15:1029510011:1.text: A divine puzzle? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could that be related to the mechanism we saw near the spring?
say:15:1029510011:1.male: A divine puzzle? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could that be related to the mechanism we saw near the spring?
say:15:1029510011:1.female: A divine puzzle? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could that be related to the mechanism we saw near the spring?

say:16:1029510012:1.text: If there's anything more to it, I wouldn't know!
say:16:1029510012:1.source_cn: 再多的东西，我也不知道了！

choice_prompt:17:1029510012.text: If there's anything more to it, I wouldn't know!
choice_prompt:17:1029510012.source_cn: 再多的东西，我也不知道了！

say:0:1029511001:0.text: I wonder what his treasure is. Gold? Gems?
say:0:1029511001:0.source_cn: 不知道月神的宝藏会是什么东西？是黄金？宝石？

say:1:1029511002:0.text: Don't be tacky, Fay! It's the moon god, it must be something incredibly sacred.
say:1:1029511002:0.source_cn: 菲小姐，太俗气了！那可是月神，一定是非常神圣的遗赠。

say:0:1029512001:0.text: A divine puzzle? Do you know how to solve it, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:0:1029512001:0.male: A divine puzzle? Do you know how to solve it, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:0:1029512001:0.female: A divine puzzle? Do you know how to solve it, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:1:1029512002:0.text: I might have an idea. Let me try.
say:1:1029512002:0.source_cn: 有一点思路，我尝试一下。
say:1:1029512002:0.male: I might have an idea. Let me try.
say:1:1029512002:0.female: I might have an idea. Let me try.

say:0:1029513001:0.text: As expected of Magister Merlin! You made it look so easy!
say:0:1029513001:0.source_cn: 不愧是梅林老师！这么轻松就解开了！
say:0:1029513001:0.male: As expected of Magister Merlin! You made it look so easy!
say:0:1029513001:0.female: As expected of Magister Merlin! You made it look so easy!

say:1:1029513002:0.text: I'm sure the next puzzle won't be any trouble at all!
say:1:1029513002:0.source_cn: 下一个谜题，也一定不在话下！
say:1:1029513002:0.male: I'm sure the next puzzle won't be any trouble at all!
say:1:1029513002:0.female: I'm sure the next puzzle won't be any trouble at all!

say:0:1029514001:0.text: It doesn't look much different. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you can do it!
say:0:1029514001:0.source_cn: 这看起来和上一个差别不大，<style=stress>...

say:1:1029514002:0.source_cn: 有了一点心得，应该问题不大。

say:0:1029515001:0.text: Amazing! This spring's activated now too!
say:0:1029515001:0.source_cn: 太棒了，这一个泉眼也打开了！

say:1:1029515002:0.text: Eh? This spring water... Nakalig's treasure can't just be the reflection of the moon...?
say:1:1029515002:0.source_cn: 诶？这涌出的泉水……月神的宝藏，总不会只是泉水中的倒映...

say:2:1029515003:0.text: The moon in the water... Over there... Is that Dionel?
say:2:1029515003:0.source_cn: 水中的月亮嘛……那边……是萨基塔里斯阁下？

say:2:1029516001:2.text: Archon Dionel! I'm so happy to see you! But if you're here...
say:2:1029516001:2.source_cn: 萨基塔里斯大人！很高兴见到您！但是您出现的话……

say:3:1029516002:1.text: Eh? I thought you'd be more glad to see me.
say:3:1029516002:1.source_cn: 嗯？我以为见到我你们会更惊喜一些。

say:5:1029516003:1.text: Oh, we are... but if you're here, it's probably not to hand over Nakalig's treasure, right...?
say:5:1029516003:1.source_cn: 是很惊喜……但是您出现的话，应该不是来给送月神的宝藏吧……

say:7:1029516004:1.text: The moon god's treasure? I certainly don't know about that.
say:7:1029516004:1.source_cn: 月神的宝藏？我这里确实没有。

say:8:1029516005:1.text: Seems like you had another successful journey, yet you are still dissatisfied with the results?
say:8:1029516005:1.source_cn: 看来你们又经历了一段不错的旅程，但是对结果似乎不够满意？

say:9:1029516006:1.text: Alya told us the legend, and then we found out that solving the puzzle would call forth the spring. And hidden in the water should be the moon god's treasure...
say:9:1029516006:1.source_cn: 阿莉雅告诉我们月神宝藏的传说，我们打听到了解开谜题就能...

choice_prompt:10:1029516006.text: Alya told us the legend, and then we found out that solving the puzzle would call forth the spring. And hidden in the water should be the moon god's treasure...
choice_prompt:10:1029516006.source_cn: 阿莉雅告诉我们月神宝藏的传说，我们打听到了解开谜题就能召唤出泉眼。而水中就隐藏着月神的宝藏……

say:11:1029516007:1.text: People have different opinions on what is real and what is false.
say:11:1029516007:1.source_cn: 真与假，只是不同人的于己之见的不同观点。

say:12:1029516008:1.text: Perhaps for you, the spring did not bring treasure as you expected, and therefore the legend is false.
say:12:1029516008:1.source_cn: 或许对你们而言，泉水涌出没有带来宝藏，这与你们预期不同...

say:13:1029516009:2.text: But for me, this little stage of the Moon Temple finally has the two springs back after so many years! Its splendor is restored!
say:13:1029516009:2.source_cn: 但于我而言，时隔数年，月神殿这一隅舞台终于又被两处泉眼...

say:14:1029516010:1.text: I can finally watch or direct new plays once more! And that is a treasure.
say:14:1029516010:1.source_cn: 我可以再次或观看或导演新的剧目，这已是至宝。

say:15:1029516011:1.text: You cannot get Nakalig's treasure, but you can have something loved by me. How about I treat you to some malt nectar?
say:15:1029516011:1.source_cn: 你们无法拿到月神的宝藏，但却可以获得我的心爱之物，我请...

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 月神宝藏的传说是假的

choice:10:1:2.text: Solving the puzzle called the spring.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 解开谜题确实能唤起泉眼
choice:10:1:2.male: Solving the puzzle called the spring.
choice:10:1:2.female: Solving the puzzle called the spring.

narration:0:1029517001:0.text:
Taking in the malt nectar proffered by the Celestial Dionel, its refreshing wheat fragrance swirls like an autumnal October breeze.
Your thoughts are submerged in beautiful memories of fruit, wheat fields, clouds, and fallen leaves.
Just a slight sip brings you this wonderful dream.
narration:0:1029517001:0.source_cn: 接过半神萨基塔里斯的麦芽露，清爽的麦香如十月秋风掠过鼻...

say:1:1029518001:1.text: Is this the moon god's treasure, Magister?
say:1:1029518001:1.source_cn: 主人，这是月神的宝藏吗？
say:1:1029518001:1.male: Is this the moon god's treasure, Magister?
say:1:1029518001:1.female: Is this the moon god's treasure, Magister?

choice_prompt:2:1029518001.text: Is this the moon god's treasure, Magister?
choice_prompt:2:1029518001.source_cn: 主人，这是月神的宝藏吗？
choice_prompt:2:1029518001.male: Is this the moon god's treasure, Magister?
choice_prompt:2:1029518001.female: Is this the moon god's treasure, Magister?

say:3:1029518002:1.text: If it is, then it's really a great dream. Wait—dream?!
say:3:1029518002:1.source_cn: 如果是的话，那还真是一场好梦啊。不对……好梦？！
say:3:1029518002:1.male: If it is, then it's really a great dream. Wait—dream?!
say:3:1029518002:1.female: If it is, then it's really a great dream. Wait—dream?!

narration:4:1029518003:1.text: You slip back into darkness, only half-conscious, while someone seems to be talking to you.
narration:4:1029518003:1.source_cn: 再度陷入黑暗，而意识朦胧间，似乎有人在交谈。

say:3:1029519002:1.text: It was lovely. I went to the Palim family's restaurant again and had their delicious mushroom soup!
say:3:1029519002:1.source_cn: 我做了个好梦，我又去帕利姆家庭餐厅，喝到了蘑菇浓汤！

say:4:1029519003:1.text: I shared it with the other knights around the fireplace on a snowy winter day...
say:4:1029519003:1.source_cn: 在大雪覆盖的冬日里，我和其它圣骑士们一起围坐在壁炉前分享它。

say:5:1029519004:1.text: I never wanted to wake up...

say:1:1029520001:1.text: I never thought I'd feel like this...
say:1:1029520001:1.source_cn: 我从未想到会有这样的感受……

choice_prompt:2:1029520001.text: I never thought I'd feel like this...
choice_prompt:2:1029520001.source_cn: 我从未想到会有这样的感受……

say:3:1029520002:1.text: ...It's quite personal, but I felt the happiness of being accepted by Dura once more—
say:3:1029520002:1.source_cn: ……只是一些个人的事情，但我再度感受到了被艾雅接纳的快乐——

say:4:1029520003:1.text: Then I was enveloped in boundless forgiveness and joy, my soul could finally find forgiveness...
say:4:1029520003:1.source_cn: 之后我便被无边无际的宽容与喜悦包裹，希望我的灵魂最终能...

say:1:1029521001:1.text: Magister, I got accepted by the Serene Lyceum!
say:1:1029521001:1.source_cn: 老师，我拿到莱希拉姆的录取通知了！
say:1:1029521001:1.male: Magister, I got accepted by the Serene Lyceum!
say:1:1029521001:1.female: Magister, I got accepted by the Serene Lyceum!

choice_prompt:2:1029521001.text: Magister, I got accepted by the Serene Lyceum!
choice_prompt:2:1029521001.source_cn: 老师，我拿到莱希拉姆的录取通知了！
choice_prompt:2:1029521001.male: Magister, I got accepted by the Serene Lyceum!
choice_prompt:2:1029521001.female: Magister, I got accepted by the Serene Lyceum!

say:3:1029521002:1.text: Ohh, it was just a dream... I thought...
say:3:1029521002:1.source_cn: 呜呜，原来是梦啊……我，还以为……

say:4:1029521003:1.text: But it doesn't matter, you've already given me a lot of guidance. I can definitely get into the Lyceum!
say:4:1029521003:1.source_cn: 不过没关系，老师你已经指点了我，我一定能入学莱希拉姆的！
say:4:1029521003:1.male: But it doesn't matter, you've already given me a lot of guidance. I can definitely get into the Lyceum!
say:4:1029521003:1.female: But it doesn't matter, you've already given me a lot of guidance. I can definitely get into the Lyceum!

say:0:1029522001:0.text: Chippy dreamed of leading the order, protecting Merlin, and defeating bad guys! What about Hammie?
say:0:1029522001:0.source_cn: 满满梦到了自己带领仓鼠骑士团，守护梅林打遍世界无敌手！...
say:0:1029522001:0.male: Chippy dreamed of leading the order, protecting Merlin, and defeating bad guys! What about Hammie?
say:0:1029522001:0.female: Chippy dreamed of leading the order, protecting Merlin, and defeating bad guys! What about Hammie?

say:1:1029522002:0.text: Silly Chippy, I'm not telling you. That's my secret with the magister!
say:1:1029522002:0.source_cn: 笨蛋满满，我不告诉你，这是我和梅林的秘密！
say:1:1029522002:0.male: Silly Chippy, I'm not telling you. That's my secret with the magister!
say:1:1029522002:0.female: Silly Chippy, I'm not telling you. That's my secret with the magister!

say:2:1029522003:0.text: Let's tell Alya about all this. She must be anxious!
say:2:1029522003:0.source_cn: 老师，我们快去告知阿莉雅结果吧，她一定很着急了！
say:2:1029522003:0.male: Let's tell Alya about all this. She must be anxious!
say:2:1029522003:0.female: Let's tell Alya about all this. She must be anxious!

narration:0:1029523001:0.text: Fay vividly recounts to Alya the legend of the village, the process of activating the spring, the malt nectar of the Celestial and the dreams.
narration:0:1029523001:0.source_cn: 菲绘声绘色地和阿莉雅讲述了村落的传说，打开泉眼机关的过...

say:2:1029523002:1.source_cn: 哇！真是一次有价值的探索。

say:3:1029523003:1.text: I'll do my best to record all of this as a reference for future scholars.
say:3:1029523003:1.source_cn: 我会努力将这些内容写下，留给其他学者作为参考的。

choice_prompt:4:1029523003.text: I'll do my best to record all of this as a reference for future scholars.
choice_prompt:4:1029523003.source_cn: 我会努力将这些内容写下，留给其他学者作为参考的。

say:5:1029523004:1.text: Because this was a truly meaningful experience.
say:5:1029523004:1.source_cn: 因为这是很有意义的事情。

say:6:1029523005:1.text: We may be researching and verifying legends now, but in a hundred or a thousand years, we might become legends ourselves.
say:6:1029523005:1.source_cn: 虽然现在是在考据与验证传说，但百年，千年以后，我们也有...

say:7:1029523006:1.text: And I'm even the witness, recorder, and communicator of this legend, which is super exciting.
say:7:1029523006:1.source_cn: 而我甚至是这一段传说的见证、记录和传颂者，听起来就很让...

say:8:1029523007:1.text: However, some new legends have been circulating recently. They don't seem to have been around for long, unlike those legends that have been passed down for generations.
say:8:1029523007:1.source_cn: 不过，最近又流传出了一些新的传说，但似乎它们流传的时间...

say:9:1029523008:1.text: I'm currently researching these. If you have time, you could help me look into them!
say:9:1029523008:1.source_cn: 我正在考据这些事。如果您有时间，就拜托多留意了！

narration:11:1029523009:1.text: Recent legends... Dionel appearing out of nowhere... Could all of these be "performances" created by Dionel?
